text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

An all-male panel can indicate a narrow recruitment culture, but it can't plausibly explain this outcome against you: you're a man, and so is the person hired. There's no mechanism by which sex bias disadvantaged you here. Raising it would weaken your credibility on the points that actually matter.

Those points are stronger. On paper you have the higher qualification and eight years running a section; "broad leadership experience" is vague and unevidenced. And the failure to provide written reasons within two weeks is a concrete procedural problem.

Send a follow-up request in writing, cite any applicable deadline for reasons, and ask specifically how each criterion was scored.
